newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends up on fund short covering, spreads.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends up on fund short covering, spreads.

text.p: WCE canola futures ended up on fund short covering and commercial bear spreading, traders said.

"We had a reversal to the upside after taking out support in the July at $396. Funds covered July shorts and bought 350 July-Nov late, UGG sold August to Cargill, Cargill bought November, commercials were bear spreading and locals were sellers," a trader said. July WCE futures crush margin rose to +1.93 Tuesday from +0.97 Monday. July-Nov spread $31, Sep-Nov $1, July-Aug $2. Volume was 5,700 lots, with 114,000 tonnes, with 502 hedge lots.
July canola rose $1.70 at $398.70, November up $1.70 at $364.70.

July flax fell $4.80 to $329.20 on commission long liquidation and UGG bought November down $3 at $311 as commission houses sold off on rain in the eastern Prairies and technical signals. RBC-DS bought Sep-Nov at even money, July-Nov $18. Volume 600.

July western barley fell $0.90 to set a new contract low of $129.70 on long liquidation. December fell $0.70 to $133.50 on hedges. Alberta Wheat Pool sold July-Oct at $2.50, Oct-Dec $1, traders said. Volume was 1,587 lots.
July feed wheat ended unchanged at $155 on hedges after setting a new contract low of $153.80. RBC-DS bought July-Oct at $3.50 from AWP. Volume was 1,014 lots.
RBC-DS sold October and December oats down the US$5 limit to US$112 and US$114 respectively to commercials, traders said.
(All prices in Canadian dollars/tonne except oats, peas).
